verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents an export to Excel for KPI data on contacts, leads, and opportunities, so some data export is a first-party feature. That export is scoped to those views, uses Excel rather than an explicitly open format, and nothing shows a full-account export for leaving. The Web API's SQL and FetchXML retrieval is a developer building block for constructing an export, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented full-tenant data export, open formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet), coverage of all record types and attachments, offboarding/portability guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: View KPI data on contacts, leads, and opportunities—and export to Excel.
